title: LUMA: Benchmarking Segmentation via a Lightweight Universal Mask Adapter
mechanism: One fixed lightweight mask-transformer head attached to any backbone (ViT, hierarchical, conv, MoE) so backbones and pretrainings can be compared under one recipe.
adaptation: Benchmark design: hold one mask head fixed and swap encoders (ResNet-34 ImageNet, ConvNeXt-T, DINOv2/DINOv3 ViT) to separate encoder from decoder effects; also a cheap way to put a mask head on the house ResNet-34.
min_experiment: LUMA head on house ResNet-34 vs house U-Net++ decoder, 5-fold; metric inactive IoU and mIoU_rob; kill if both below house by > 0.01.
evidence: R: matches EoMT at cost parity; 20 backbones, 11 pretraining schemes on ADE20K/COCO/Cityscapes; pretraining objective, not architecture, governs quality; plain ViT holds throughput Pareto front. Code stated github.com/tobna/LUMA (not opened).
